topics.name: Causal and Uncertainty-Aware Statistical Learning
topics.summary: These papers combine causal estimation, conformal calibration, and representation-level abstraction to quantify effects or uncertainty under confounding, limited samples, and distribution shift. Applications span marketplaces, structured prediction, and engineering reliability, emphasizing coverage, calibration, and transportable explanations.

topics.name: Optimization Theory and Online Decision Making
topics.summary: Analyses of online updates, low-rank factorization, and regularized nonconvex objectives derive regret, feasibility, or convergence guarantees. The recurring payoff is fewer updates or stronger optimization behavior without assuming ideal initialization or strict constraint conditions.

topics.name: Robust and Adversarial Machine Learning
topics.summary: Defense methods search for triggers, train with certifiable or adversarial objectives, and maintain multiple plausible adaptations under shift. Benchmarks across language, vision, and federated-style transfer measure both attack resistance and retained task accuracy.

topics.name: AI Security, Privacy, and Governance
topics.summary: The studies audit deployed models through calibration, membership and inversion probes, vulnerability graphs, and lifecycle risk controls. They connect sensitive-information exposure and operational failure to concrete routing, reporting, and assurance practices.

topics.name: Grounded Language-Model Reasoning
topics.summary: Grounding is enforced with structured query plans, evidence-linked generation, spatial representations, and source checks. Across retrieval, document, and multimodal tasks, explicit intermediate structure catches unsupported claims and visual or tabular misreadings.

topics.name: LLM Behavioral Evaluation and Alignment
topics.summary: Behavioral tests vary interaction rules, hidden cues, cultural language, and governing criteria, while process-level supervision and evaluator calibration shape safer updates. Results expose brittle defaults and show that correctness, fairness, and reasoning quality can diverge.

topics.name: Selective Prediction and Adaptive Inference
topics.summary: Confidence gates, sparse cascades, and selective retrieval decide when expensive computation or deferral is warranted. Decision, recommendation, and agent settings show lower average cost when escalation is tied to uncertainty or task difficulty.

topics.name: Agent Workflows, Memory, and Governance
topics.summary: Tool-using agents are evaluated through traces, reversible memory, diagnosed failures, and orchestration policies. Across enterprise, computer-use, and research tasks, selective history, explicit coordination, and outcome-aware feedback improve completion while making execution auditable.

topics.name: LLM Adaptation and Efficient Inference
topics.summary: Parameter-efficient adapters, recurrent blocks, cache compression, token retrieval, and selective operator use reduce update or inference cost. Studies on language and multimodal models show that routing by layer, token, or task can retain capability under tight memory and compute budgets.

topics.name: Mechanistic Interpretability
topics.summary: Interpretability studies align residual coordinates across layers and checkpoints, inspect sparse or neuron-level features, and test latent interventions. Stable measurement frames make internal causes easier to compare and more useful for steering or hallucination analysis.

topics.name: Multimodal Model Reliability and Safety
topics.summary: Multimodal evaluations use controlled perturbations, paired video tests, activation steering, and uncertainty heads to separate genuine cross-modal evidence from language priors. Findings center on hallucination, unsafe responses, and confidence failures that aggregate scores conceal.

topics.name: Synthetic Media Detection
topics.summary: Detector audits compare content, style, and generator changes across image, text, and video data, including open-world and few-shot settings. Benchmark success can reflect source or generator artifacts unless adaptation and cross-generator testing are included.

topics.name: Diffusion-Based Image Generation and Editing
topics.summary: Diffusion and flow-based generators use spatial attention, geometry, latent trajectories, transport guidance, and content-preserving constraints for editing and synthesis. Controlled conditioning improves semantic binding, detail, and prompt faithfulness without full retraining.

topics.name: Video Generation and Action Understanding
topics.summary: Video systems allocate computation across sampling or frames, model temporal actions and surgical events, and align local visual tokens with broader language context. Evaluations emphasize long-range motion, skill quality, and the balance between detail preservation and efficient generation.

topics.name: Image Restoration and Computational Tomography
topics.summary: Restoration methods combine diffusion or implicit representations with projection consistency, wavelet structure, and real degradation samples. Sparse-view tomography and real-world super-resolution experiments report cleaner anatomy or detail with fewer assumptions about synthetic corruption.

topics.name: 3D Reconstruction and Multi-View Vision
topics.summary: Multi-view and dynamic reconstruction methods fuse geometry, temporal updates, Gaussian primitives, and view-dependent features to recover scenes, articulated subjects, or occupancy. Results target sparse observations, occlusion, and consistent identity while keeping rendering or inference practical.

topics.name: Visual Representation and Efficient Recognition
topics.summary: Frozen features, cross-modal matching, modality-aware routing, masked pretraining, and compact detection heads reuse visual structure under limited labels or hardware. Experiments across multispectral, remote-sensing, edge, and long-tailed recognition favor targeted representations over uniformly larger networks.

topics.name: Multisensor Learning and Perceptual Uncertainty
topics.summary: Heterogeneous sensors are aligned with teachers, active queries, shared representations, and distribution-aware uncertainty models. Radar, tactile, biosignal, and visual experiments show better ambiguity detection and transfer when missing measurements and device differences are modeled explicitly.

topics.name: Spatial Reasoning for Embodied Perception
topics.summary: Scene graphs, semantic maps, foundation-model pruning, and structured spatial controls support navigation and 3D reasoning from incomplete observations. Embodied and multimodal benchmarks show gains when relations, reference frames, and geometric validity are checked before action or prediction.

topics.name: Autonomous Driving Perception and Mapping
topics.summary: Driving perception studies combine sparse radar-camera evidence, height-aware lane geometry, route-linked memory, and interventions on learned motion predictions. Evaluations focus on long-range detection, map completeness, and whether policies use surrounding traffic structure.

topics.name: Autonomous Driving Simulation and World Models
topics.summary: Autonomous-system testing and simulation convert crash narratives, risk-directed exploration, traffic context, and controllable future scenes into targeted rollouts. Driving and air-traffic settings report better rare-failure discovery or planning realism when scenarios are structured around actions and social context.

topics.name: Localization, Calibration, and Visual Odometry
topics.summary: Localization pipelines combine gravity, ground geometry, depth, inertial filtering, rolling-shutter cues, and passive radiometric effects. UAV, underwater, and unconventional-camera experiments show reduced drift when calibration and motion estimation respect sensor-specific observability.

topics.name: UAV and Networked Aerial Control
topics.summary: Aerial control methods pair distributed prediction, adaptive dynamics models, iterative learning, and communication-aware execution with energy or cloud constraints. UAV studies report more reliable tracking and lower resource use under disturbances and changing connectivity.

topics.name: Learning-Based Control and Safe Reinforcement Learning
topics.summary: Policy learning and model-based control use offline data, randomized dynamics, dense stage rewards, contact-aware rollouts, and constrained execution. Across manipulators, vehicles, fusion devices, and humanoids, physical structure and explicit safety checks improve transfer and stability.

topics.name: Tactile and Robust Robotic Manipulation
topics.summary: Manipulation systems combine tactile sequences, vision-language cues, future-contact prediction, temporal interaction memory, and retargeted demonstrations. Benchmarks and hardware trials emphasize robustness to new objects, materials, skills, perturbations, and long-horizon contact.

topics.name: Robot Navigation and Motion Planning
topics.summary: Navigation and planning methods use near-field geometry, monocular reconstruction, semantic latent maps, predictive vehicle models, any-angle search, and reusable skills. Results target efficient motion through clutter or constrained road geometry with less global mapping and expert intervention.

topics.name: Embodied Agents and Robot World Models
topics.summary: Embodied agents integrate semantic maps, multimodal commands, metric waypoints, world models, human interaction, and damage-aware simulation. The shared focus is executable long-horizon behavior that remains stable under changing dynamics, social context, and resource limits.

topics.name: Speech and Audio Modeling
topics.summary: Speech and audio studies cover expressive prosody, atypical and child speech, clinical language signals, enhancement, generation, and instrument or affect recognition. They use speaker-aware evaluation, graph or prototype representations, simulation, and adaptive sampling to expose domain and low-resource limitations.

topics.name: Medical Imaging and Clinical AI
topics.summary: Clinical systems adapt pretrained or parameter-efficient vision models for reports, pathology, segmentation, cardiac and retinal measurements, and screening. Temporal consistency, anatomical structure, external validation, and selective confidence repeatedly matter more than headline accuracy alone.

topics.name: Biomedical Representation and Biosignal Learning
topics.summary: Biomedical learning uses molecular, protein, dental, cryo-EM, single-cell, and physiological data with few-shot tabular models, spectral geometry, sparse alignment, and transferable channel embeddings. The studies emphasize useful structure when labels, connectivity, or sensor layouts are incomplete.

topics.name: Scientific Machine Learning and Forecasting
topics.summary: Scientific models combine tensor updates, Gaussian processes, flow matching, randomized domain decomposition, evolutionary architecture search, and generative sequence forecasting. Applications in mechanics, seismic inversion, stochastic fields, and environmental time series trade runtime for physically plausible long-horizon predictions.

topics.name: Laboratory Automation and Scientific Research Agents
topics.summary: Laboratory and research agents translate natural-language goals into instrument procedures, code, data construction, experiments, and scientific artifacts. Runtime monitors, provenance, checkpoint checks, and supercomputing workflows improve reproducibility while exposing limits in experimental breadth and validation.

topics.name: Graph Representation Learning
topics.summary: Graph-learning methods treat topology as more than an input feature: learned embeddings support interpretable visual layouts, while text-attributed graph models couple neighborhood structure with generated descriptions. Both report gains when relational context guides downstream reasoning.

topics.name: Formal Logic and Verified Reasoning
topics.summary: Formal systems model information exchange, belief change, agency, graded understanding, and admissible workflow transitions with semantics, proof systems, or completeness results. Verified mathematics adds solver and interval checks, linking symbolic guarantees to executable search.

topics.name: Verified Planning and Combinatorial Optimization
topics.summary: Planning agents combine typed actions, symbolic world states, solver feedback, and adaptive decomposition for CAD, multi-robot, routing, and other discrete tasks. Verification and specialized inner search make repairs and long-horizon commitments more dependable under changing instances.

topics.name: Scholarly Literature Mining
topics.summary: Literature-mining pipelines extract multimodal entities, methods, topics, and collaboration signals from scholarly records. Their analyses connect institutional structure and novelty to specific research practices while testing whether figures, audio, and fine-grained metadata improve discovery.

topics.name: Dataset Quality and Label-Efficient Learning
topics.summary: Data-centric studies test deterministic transformations, corrected labels, duplicate removal, label propagation, and synthetic sample selection. Results show that benchmark integrity and the source of apparent semi-supervised or synthetic-data gains can matter as much as the learner.

topics.name: Tabular and Federated Learning Under Data Constraints
topics.summary: Tabular and federated methods address missing-not-at-random values, latent synthesis, client heterogeneity, sparse updates, and label-free distillation. Evaluation focuses on fidelity, communication, privacy, and whether gains reflect genuine supervision rather than proxy-label leakage.

topics.name: Wireless, Edge, and In-Sensor Machine Learning
topics.summary: Wireless and edge systems co-design signal objectives, reflective surfaces, device adaptation, hardware-aware networks, and reinforcement-learned allocation. Experiments target semantic freshness, latency, energy, open-set transfer, and tiny-memory inference close to the sensor.

topics.name: Industrial Process Control and Engineering Reliability
topics.summary: Industrial methods combine plant ontologies, symbolic safety rules, language-guided recovery, and neural reliability surrogates with simulation or uncertainty estimation. The recurring goal is actionable fault response and calibrated risk under expensive or incomplete engineering measurements.

topics.name: Remote Sensing and Geospatial Scene Modeling
topics.summary: Geospatial generation and forestry analysis use geographic primitives, octree LiDAR, expert decision structures, and downstream scene or inventory tasks. Results stress geometric alignment, seasonal and sensor variation, and practical value when annotations are scarce.

topics.name: Human-AI Interaction and Governance
topics.summary: Human-centered studies examine common ground, participation, oversight, attachment, and judgments of AI-assisted outputs. Experiments show that intervention style, power differences, and domain meaning shape trust and acceptance beyond surface quality or task success.

topics.name: Educational Technology and Classroom Analytics
topics.summary: Educational AI combines interaction traces and classroom video to estimate epistemic engagement and sustained attention in authentic settings. The systems support scalable monitoring while revealing gaps between visible activity and deeper learning.

topics.name: Computational Cultural Heritage
topics.summary: Computational heritage work links archival records with graph structure, provenance, and geometry-constrained reconstruction. The resulting analyses use reproducible statistics to study transmission, design rules, and relationships among dispersed historical artifacts.

topics.name: Face Privacy and Fairness
topics.summary: Face-analysis studies pair identity-protective perturbations with subgroup-aware detection evaluation. They show that privacy defenses and fairness claims require spatially targeted attacks, identity-sensitive targets, and explicit demographic reporting.

topics.name: Neuromorphic and Biologically Inspired Computing
topics.summary: Event-driven networks, biologically motivated credit assignment, and physical sampling hardware reduce dense computation or relax backpropagation assumptions. Vision, control, anomaly warning, and log-processing experiments compare accuracy with energy, stability, and hardware cost.

topics.name: Differentiable Vector Graphics
topics.summary: Differentiable graphics systems represent layouts as executable programs or continuous curve fields and optimize element-level structure. Their evaluations address pixel accuracy, editability, and the gap between semantic similarity and geometric fidelity.

topics.name: Software Engineering and Computer-Use Agents
topics.summary: Software and browser agents learn reusable skills from interaction traces, route tasks by early evidence, and stress-test algorithmic reasoning with altered programming problems. Results favor compositional skills and cost-aware escalation over one-shot generation.

topics.name: Language Agents for Financial Markets
topics.summary: Financial-agent studies combine market signals, discourse, risk controls, and mandate-aware re-grounding in simulated asset environments. Periodic profile checks can stabilize behavior, but performance and adherence vary with market regime and agent disposition.
